// ── Types ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
type IntervalKey = "1m" | "5m" | "15m" | "60m";
type RiskLevel   = "safe" | "risky" | "riskiest" | "all";
type SignalOutcome = "win_tp1" | "win_tp2" | "loss" | "open";

interface MCSignal {
  time: number; price: number; tp1: number; tp2: number; sl: number;
  riskLevel: "safe" | "risky" | "riskiest";
  outcome: SignalOutcome; pnl: number; rth: boolean;
}

interface TimedPath { time: number; value: number }

interface MCResult {
  signals: MCSignal[];
  completedSignals: MCSignal[];
  iterations: number;
  /** Each element is an array of {time, value} equity points (one per real signal timestamp) */
  sampledPaths: TimedPath[][];
  medianPath:   TimedPath[];
  p10Path:      TimedPath[];
  p90Path:      TimedPath[];
  winRate:    number;
  avgPnl:     number;
  maxDrawdown: number;
  totalTrades: number;
}

interface SuggestedParams {
  tp1: number; tp2: number; sl: number;
  ev: number; winRate: number; tier: string;
}

// ── RTH / break helpers ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
function isRTH(ts: number): boolean {
  const d = new Date(ts * 1000);
  if (d.getUTCDay() === 0 || d.getUTCDay() === 6) return false;
  const m = d.getUTCHours() * 60 + d.getUTCMinutes();
  return m >= 13 * 60 + 30 && m < 21 * 60;
}
const _etFmt = new Intl.DateTimeFormat("en-US", {
  timeZone: "America/New_York", hour: "2-digit", minute: "2-digit", hour12: false,
});
function isMarketBreak(ts: number): boolean {
  const d = new Date(ts * 1000);
  if (d.getUTCDay() === 0 || d.getUTCDay() === 6) return false;
  const et = _etFmt.format(d);
  const col = et.indexOf(":");
  const etMins = parseInt(et.slice(0, col)) * 60 + parseInt(et.slice(col + 1));
  return etMins >= 16 * 60 + 30 && etMins < 18 * 60;
}

// ── Vector helpers (mirror market.tsx exactly) ─────────────────────────────────
const VEC_LENGTH = 20;
function computeVectorLine(candles: CandleBar[]): Array<{ time: number; value: number }> {
  if (!candles.length) return [];
  const s = [...candles].sort((a, b) => a.time - b.time).filter(c => c.rth !== false);
  const n = s.length;
  const lb = new Array<number>(n);
  for (let i = 0; i < n; i++) {
    let lo = s[i].low;
    for (let j = Math.max(0, i - VEC_LENGTH + 1); j < i; j++) if (s[j].low < lo) lo = s[j].low;
    lb[i] = lo;
  }
  const result: Array<{ time: number; value: number }> = [];
  for (let i = 0; i < n; i++) {
    let hi = lb[i];
    for (let j = Math.max(0, i - VEC_LENGTH + 1); j < i; j++) if (lb[j] > hi) hi = lb[j];
    result.push({ time: s[i].time, value: hi });
  }
  return result;
}

function forwardFillVector(
  vec: Array<{ time: number; value: number }>,
  chartTimes: number[]
): Array<{ time: number; value: number }> {
  if (!vec.length || !chartTimes.length) return [];
  const sorted = [...vec].sort((a, b) => a.time - b.time);
  const result: Array<{ time: number; value: number }> = [];
  let vi = 0;
  for (const t of chartTimes) {
    while (vi + 1 < sorted.length && sorted[vi + 1].time <= t) vi++;
    if (sorted[vi] && sorted[vi].time <= t) result.push({ time: t, value: sorted[vi].value });
  }
  return result;
}

function aggToInterval(candles: CandleBar[], intervalSec: number): CandleBar[] {
  if (!candles.length) return [];
  const s = [...candles].sort((a, b) => a.time - b.time);
  const map = new Map<number, CandleBar>();
  for (const c of s) {
    const bucket = Math.floor(c.time / intervalSec) * intervalSec;
    const ex = map.get(bucket);
    if (!ex) { map.set(bucket, { ...c, time: bucket }); }
    else {
      ex.high = Math.max(ex.high, c.high); ex.low = Math.min(ex.low, c.low);
      ex.close = c.close; ex.volume = (ex.volume ?? 0) + (c.volume ?? 0);
    }
  }
  return Array.from(map.values()).sort((a, b) => a.time - b.time);
}

// ── Signal computation (mirrors market.tsx allConfluenceSignals) ───────────────
const MILK_TOL  = 2.0;
const COOLDOWN  = 10;
const ETH_CD    = 20;

function computeBacktestSignals(
  candles: CandleBar[],
  vectorLine: Array<{ time: number; value: number }>,
  extraVecMaps: Map<number, number>[],
  mlZones: Array<{ from_ts: number; to_ts: number; top: number; bottom: number; is_bull: boolean; score: number }>,
  interval: IntervalKey,
  tp1: number, tp2: number, sl: number,
): MCSignal[] {
  if (!candles.length) return [];
  const sorted  = [...candles].sort((a, b) => a.time - b.time);
  const vecMap  = new Map(vectorLine.map(v => [v.time, v.value]));
  let lastLong = -COOLDOWN, lastLongEth = -ETH_CD;
  const sigs: MCSignal[] = [];

  for (let i = 0; i < sorted.length; i++) {
    const c = sorted[i];
    const lb = vecMap.get(c.time);
    const prevLb = i >= 3 ? vecMap.get(sorted[i - 3].time) : undefined;
    if (isMarketBreak(c.time)) continue;
    if (!(lb != null && c.close > lb)) continue;
    if (lb != null && prevLb != null && lb < prevLb) continue;

    const utcH    = (c.time / 3600 | 0) % 24;
    const utcM    = (c.time / 60 | 0) % 60;
    const minsUtc = utcH * 60 + utcM;
    const isRthForMilk = (c.rth ?? isRTH(c.time)) && minsUtc >= 13 * 60 + 30 && minsUtc < 20 * 60 + 30;

    let milkOk = false;
    if (isRthForMilk) {
      for (const z of mlZones) {
        if (!z.is_bull) continue;
        if (c.time < z.from_ts || c.time > z.to_ts) continue;
        if (c.low <= z.top + MILK_TOL && c.close >= z.bottom - MILK_TOL) { milkOk = true; break; }
      }
    }
    const secOk  = extraVecMaps.some(m => { const v = m.get(c.time); return v != null && c.close > v; });

    let level: "safe" | "risky" | "riskiest" = milkOk ? "safe" : secOk ? "risky" : "riskiest";
    if (c.rth && utcH >= 20 && level !== "safe") continue;

    const cd = c.rth ? COOLDOWN : ETH_CD;
    if (i - (c.rth ? lastLong : lastLongEth) < cd) continue;
    if (c.rth) lastLong = i; else lastLongEth = i;

    for (const z of mlZones) {
      if (z.is_bull) continue;
      if (c.time < z.from_ts || c.time > z.to_ts) continue;
      const d = z.bottom - c.close;
      if (d >= 0 && d <= 5.0) { if (level === "safe") level = "risky"; else if (level === "risky") level = "riskiest"; break; }
    }

    const entry = c.close;
    const sigTp1 = entry + tp1, sigTp2 = entry + tp2, sigSl = entry - sl;

    let outcome: SignalOutcome = "open"; let pnl = 0;
    for (let j = i + 1; j < sorted.length; j++) {
      const f = sorted[j];
      if (f.high >= sigTp2) { outcome = "win_tp2"; pnl = tp2; break; }
      if (f.high >= sigTp1) { outcome = "win_tp1"; pnl = tp1; break; }
      if (f.low  <= sigSl)  { outcome = "loss";    pnl = -sl; break; }
    }
    if (outcome === "open") pnl = sorted[Math.min(sorted.length - 1, i + 48)].close - entry;

    sigs.push({ time: c.time, price: entry, tp1: sigTp1, tp2: sigTp2, sl: sigSl, riskLevel: level, outcome, pnl, rth: c.rth ?? isRTH(c.time) });
  }
  return sigs;
}

// ── Monte Carlo (time-indexed paths using real signal timestamps) ───────────────
function runMonteCarlo(signals: MCSignal[], iterations = 500, startBalance = 10_000): MCResult {
  const completed = signals.filter(s => s.outcome !== "open");
  const n = completed.length;

  if (n === 0) {
    return { signals, completedSignals: [], iterations, sampledPaths: [], medianPath: [], p10Path: [], p90Path: [], winRate: 0, avgPnl: 0, maxDrawdown: 0, totalTrades: 0 };
  }

  const wins   = completed.filter(s => s.outcome !== "loss").length;
  const avgPnl = completed.reduce((s, x) => s + x.pnl, 0) / n;

  // Build time-indexed paths: each iteration uses real signal times for X axis
  // but samples outcomes with replacement from the completed set.
  const allPaths: TimedPath[][] = [];
  for (let iter = 0; iter < iterations; iter++) {
    const path: TimedPath[] = [{ time: completed[0].time - 300, value: startBalance }];
    let bal = startBalance;
    for (let t = 0; t < n; t++) {
      const sample = completed[Math.floor(Math.random() * n)];
      bal += sample.pnl;
      path.push({ time: completed[t].time, value: bal });
    }
    allPaths.push(path);
  }

  // Compute percentile paths step-by-step
  const medianPath: TimedPath[] = [];
  const p10Path:    TimedPath[] = [];
  const p90Path:    TimedPath[] = [];
  for (let i = 0; i <= n; i++) {
    const vals = allPaths.map(p => p[i].value).sort((a, b) => a - b);
    const t    = allPaths[0][i].time;
    medianPath.push({ time: t, value: vals[Math.floor(vals.length * 0.50)] });
    p10Path.push   ({ time: t, value: vals[Math.floor(vals.length * 0.10)] });
    p90Path.push   ({ time: t, value: vals[Math.floor(vals.length * 0.90)] });
  }

  // Max drawdown from median path
  let peak = startBalance, maxDD = 0;
  for (const pt of medianPath) {
    if (pt.value > peak) peak = pt.value;
    const dd = (peak - pt.value) / peak;
    if (dd > maxDD) maxDD = dd;
  }

  // Return at most 150 sample paths for rendering
  const sampledPaths = allPaths.slice(0, 150);

  return { signals, completedSignals: completed, iterations, sampledPaths, medianPath, p10Path, p90Path, winRate: wins / n, avgPnl, maxDrawdown: maxDD, totalTrades: n };
}

// ── Grid-search: find TP1/SL combo that maximises EV per tier ─────────────────
function generateSuggestion(signals: MCSignal[], tier: string): SuggestedParams | null {
  const tierSigs = tier === "all" ? signals.filter(s => s.outcome !== "open") : signals.filter(s => s.riskLevel === tier && s.outcome !== "open");
  if (tierSigs.length < 5) return null;

  // We need the raw candle walk-forward to re-evaluate TP/SL combos.
  // Since MCSignal already has price/outcome, we re-simulate different TP/SL levels
  // by using the original pnl sign as a proxy: if the signal won, it moved at least TP1 pts.
  // For a proper grid search we use the signal's actual pnl (raw pts moved before the stored exit).
  // Instead, approximate: for each TP/SL combo, count how many signals would win given TP pts reached.
  // We do this by comparing stored pnl vs the candidate TP/SL levels.
  const TP_RANGE = [5, 7.5, 10, 12.5, 15, 17.5, 20];
  const SL_RANGE = [2.5, 3, 4, 5, 6, 7, 8];

  let bestEV = -Infinity;
  let best: SuggestedParams | null = null;

  for (const tp1 of TP_RANGE) {
    for (const sl of SL_RANGE) {
      if (tp1 <= sl) continue;
      // For each signal, re-evaluate outcome under the new TP/SL
      // If original outcome was a win (pnl > 0), assume price moved pnl pts favourably;
      // If original was a loss (pnl < 0), assume price moved |pnl| pts against.
      let wins = 0;
      for (const s of tierSigs) {
        if (s.outcome === "win_tp1" || s.outcome === "win_tp2") {
          // Price hit at least the original TP. It would also hit tp1 if tp1 ≤ original pnl.
          if (s.pnl >= tp1) wins++;
        } else {
          // Loss: price moved at least sl pts against us. A tighter SL would still lose.
          // A wider SL might save it — but we have no data beyond the original SL exit.
          // Assume: if sl ≥ stored sl (original SL pts), it still lost; otherwise it may have recovered.
          // Conservative: loss stays a loss regardless of wider SL.
        }
      }
      const wr = wins / tierSigs.length;
      const ev = wr * tp1 - (1 - wr) * sl;
      if (ev > bestEV) {
        bestEV = ev;
        best = { tp1, tp2: tp1 * 2, sl, ev, winRate: wr, tier };
      }
    }
  }
  return best;
}

// ── Equity curve chart (lightweight-charts) ────────────────────────────────────
function MCEquityChart({
  result,
  startBalance,
}: {
  result: MCResult;
  startBalance: number;
}) {
  const containerRef = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null);
  const canvasRef    = useRef<HTMLCanvasElement | null>(null);
  const chartRef     = useRef<IChartApi | null>(null);
  const medRef = useRef<ISeriesApi<"Line"> | null>(null);
  const p10Ref = useRef<ISeriesApi<"Line"> | null>(null);
  const p90Ref = useRef<ISeriesApi<"Line"> | null>(null);

  // Init chart once
  useLayoutEffect(() => {
    if (!containerRef.current || chartRef.current) return;
    const el = containerRef.current;

    const chart = createChart(el, {
      layout: {
        background: { type: ColorType.Solid, color: "#05080d" },
        textColor:  "#4a6080",
        fontFamily: "'Trebuchet MS', monospace",
        fontSize:   10,
      },
      grid: { vertLines: { color: "#111a2644" }, horzLines: { color: "#111a2644" } },
      crosshair: { mode: 0 },
      rightPriceScale: { borderColor: "#111a26", scaleMargins: { top: 0.06, bottom: 0.06 } },
      timeScale: { borderColor: "#111a26", timeVisible: true, secondsVisible: false },
      handleScroll: true,
      handleScale: true,
      width:  el.clientWidth,
      height: el.clientHeight,
    });

    medRef.current = chart.addSeries(LineSeries, {
      color: "#26c87a", lineWidth: 2, title: "Median",
      autoscaleInfoProvider: () => null,
    });
    p90Ref.current = chart.addSeries(LineSeries, {
      color: "rgba(38,200,122,0.45)", lineWidth: 1, lineStyle: LineStyle.Dashed, title: "P90",
      autoscaleInfoProvider: () => null,
    });
    p10Ref.current = chart.addSeries(LineSeries, {
      color: "rgba(239,83,80,0.45)", lineWidth: 1, lineStyle: LineStyle.Dashed, title: "P10",
      autoscaleInfoProvider: () => null,
    });

    // Canvas overlay for individual paths
    const canvas = document.createElement("canvas");
    canvas.style.cssText = "position:absolute;inset:0;pointer-events:none;";
    el.style.position = "relative";
    el.appendChild(canvas);
    canvasRef.current = canvas;

    chartRef.current = chart;

    const obs = new ResizeObserver(() => {
      chart.applyOptions({ width: el.clientWidth, height: el.clientHeight });
      if (canvas) { canvas.width = el.clientWidth; canvas.height = el.clientHeight; }
    });
    obs.observe(el);

    return () => {
      obs.disconnect();
      chart.remove();
      canvas.remove();
      chartRef.current = null;
      medRef.current = null; p90Ref.current = null; p10Ref.current = null;
    };
  }, []);

  // Push data whenever result changes
  useEffect(() => {
    if (!chartRef.current || !medRef.current || !p10Ref.current || !p90Ref.current) return;
    if (!result.medianPath.length) return;

    const toTs = (arr: TimedPath[]) => arr.map(p => ({ time: p.time as any, value: p.value }));
    medRef.current.setData(toTs(result.medianPath));
    p90Ref.current.setData(toTs(result.p90Path));
    p10Ref.current.setData(toTs(result.p10Path));
    chartRef.current.timeScale().fitContent();

    // Draw individual paths on canvas
    const canvas = canvasRef.current;
    if (!canvas || !result.sampledPaths.length) return;
    const chart = chartRef.current;
    const series = medRef.current;
    const W = canvas.clientWidth, H = canvas.clientHeight;
    canvas.width = W; canvas.height = H;
    const ctx = canvas.getContext("2d");
    if (!ctx) return;
    ctx.clearRect(0, 0, W, H);

    const ts = chart.timeScale();
    // Clamp values for priceToCoordinate
    const allVals = result.sampledPaths.flatMap(p => p.map(x => x.value));
    const minV = Math.min(...allVals, startBalance * 0.7);
    const maxV = Math.max(...allVals, startBalance * 1.3);
    function yOf(v: number) {
      const coord = series.priceToCoordinate(v);
      if (coord !== null) return coord;
      return H - ((v - minV) / (maxV - minV)) * H;
    }

    // Show all sampled paths as very faint thin lines
    ctx.globalAlpha = 0.06;
    ctx.strokeStyle = "#60a5fa";
    ctx.lineWidth   = 0.7;
    for (const path of result.sampledPaths) {
      ctx.beginPath();
      let started = false;
      for (const pt of path) {
        const x = ts.timeToCoordinate(pt.time as any);
        const y = yOf(pt.value);
        if (x === null) { started = false; continue; }
        if (!started) { ctx.moveTo(x, y); started = true; }
        else ctx.lineTo(x, y);
      }
      ctx.stroke();
    }

    // Starting balance reference line
    ctx.globalAlpha = 0.2;
    ctx.strokeStyle = "#b8c8d8";
    ctx.setLineDash([4, 3]);
    ctx.lineWidth = 1;
    const ySB = yOf(startBalance);
    ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(0, ySB); ctx.lineTo(W, ySB); ctx.stroke();
    ctx.setLineDash([]);
    ctx.globalAlpha = 1;
  }, [result, startBalance]);

  return <div ref={containerRef} style={{ width: "100%", height: "100%" }} />;
}

// ── MW colors ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
const MW = {
  bg: "#05080d", panel: "#090d14", toolbar: "#0b1018",
  border: "#111a26", text: "#b8c8d8", muted: "#4a6080",
  accent: "#1a72d4", up: "#2196f3", down: "#c62828",
};

const FUTURES_SYMBOLS = ["MES", "ES=F", "NQ=F", "YM=F", "CL=F", "GC=F"];
const DEFAULT_TP1 = 10, DEFAULT_TP2 = 20, DEFAULT_SL = 5;

export default function MonteCarloPage() {
  const [selectedSymbol, setSelectedSymbol] = useState("MES");
  const [interval, setInterval]             = useState<IntervalKey>("5m");
  const [riskFilter, setRiskFilter]         = useState<RiskLevel>("all");
  const [mode, setMode]   = useState<"backtest" | "montecarlo" | null>(null);
  const [showNotesPanel, setShowNotesPanel] = useState(false);
  const [mcResult, setMcResult]   = useState<MCResult | null>(null);
  const [isRunning, setIsRunning] = useState(false);
  const [suggestion, setSuggestion] = useState<SuggestedParams | null>(null);
  const [showSuggestion, setShowSuggestion] = useState(false);
  const [startBalance] = useState(10_000);

  const [editConfig, setEditConfig] = useState({
    safe:     { tp1: String(DEFAULT_TP1), tp2: String(DEFAULT_TP2), sl: String(DEFAULT_SL) },
    risky:    { tp1: String(DEFAULT_TP1), tp2: String(DEFAULT_TP2), sl: String(DEFAULT_SL) },
    riskiest: { tp1: String(DEFAULT_TP1), tp2: String(DEFAULT_TP2), sl: String(DEFAULT_SL) },
  });
  const [saveStatus, setSaveStatus] = useState<"idle" | "saving" | "saved" | "error">("idle");
  const [learningsNote, setLearningsNote] = useState("");
  const [noteStatus, setNoteStatus] = useState<"idle" | "saving" | "saved">("idle");

  const chartRef = useRef<ChartHandle>(null);

  // Load strategy config
  const { data: strategyConfig } = useQuery<any>({
    queryKey: ["/api/strategy/config"],
    queryFn: async () => { const r = await fetch("/api/strategy/config"); return r.ok ? r.json() : {}; },
    staleTime: 60_000,
  });

  useEffect(() => {
    if (!strategyConfig || typeof strategyConfig !== "object") return;
    setEditConfig({
      safe:     { tp1: String(strategyConfig.safe?.tp1_fixed ?? DEFAULT_TP1), tp2: String(strategyConfig.safe?.tp2_fixed ?? DEFAULT_TP2), sl: String(strategyConfig.safe?.sl_fixed ?? DEFAULT_SL) },
      risky:    { tp1: String(strategyConfig.risky?.tp1_fixed ?? DEFAULT_TP1), tp2: String(strategyConfig.risky?.tp2_fixed ?? DEFAULT_TP2), sl: String(strategyConfig.risky?.sl_fixed ?? DEFAULT_SL) },
      riskiest: { tp1: String(strategyConfig.riskiest?.tp1_fixed ?? DEFAULT_TP1), tp2: String(strategyConfig.riskiest?.tp2_fixed ?? DEFAULT_TP2), sl: String(strategyConfig.riskiest?.sl_fixed ?? DEFAULT_SL) },
    });
  }, [strategyConfig]);

  // Data fetches
  const fromTs = useMemo(() => Math.floor(Date.now() / 1000) - 90 * 86400, []);
  const toTs   = useMemo(() => Math.floor(Date.now() / 1000) + 3600, []);
  const fetchInterval = interval === "60m" ? "60m" : interval === "1m" ? "1m" : "5m";

  const { data: rawCandleData, isLoading: candlesLoading } = useQuery<{ symbol: string; interval: string; candles: CandleBar[] }>({
    queryKey: ["/api/data/cached-continuous", selectedSymbol, fetchInterval, fromTs, toTs],
    queryFn: async () => {
      const r = await fetch(`/api/data/cached-continuous/${selectedSymbol}/${fetchInterval}?from=${fromTs}&to=${toTs}`);
      if (!r.ok) throw new Error("Failed");
      return r.json();
    },
    staleTime: 60_000,
  });

  const { data: raw1mData } = useQuery<{ candles: CandleBar[] }>({
    queryKey: ["/api/data/cached-continuous", selectedSymbol, "1m", fromTs, toTs],
    queryFn: async () => {
      const r = await fetch(`/api/data/cached-continuous/${selectedSymbol}/1m?from=${fromTs}&to=${toTs}`);
      if (!r.ok) throw new Error("Failed");
      return r.json();
    },
    enabled: fetchInterval !== "1m", staleTime: 5 * 60_000,
  });

  const { data: raw60mData } = useQuery<{ candles: CandleBar[] }>({
    queryKey: ["/api/data/cached-continuous", selectedSymbol, "60m", fromTs, toTs],
    queryFn: async () => {
      const r = await fetch(`/api/data/cached-continuous/${selectedSymbol}/60m?from=${fromTs}&to=${toTs}`);
      if (!r.ok) throw new Error("Failed");
      return r.json();
    },
    enabled: fetchInterval !== "60m", staleTime: 5 * 60_000,
  });

  const { data: mlZonesData } = useQuery<{ zones: Array<{ from_ts: number; to_ts: number; top: number; bottom: number; is_bull: boolean; score: number }> }>({
    queryKey: ["/api/ml/zones/strong", fromTs, toTs],
    queryFn: async () => {
      const r = await fetch(`/api/ml/zones/strong?from_ts=${fromTs}&to_ts=${toTs}`);
      if (!r.ok) throw new Error("Failed");
      return r.json();
    },
    staleTime: 30 * 60_000,
  });

  const candleData = useMemo(() => {
    if (!rawCandleData?.candles?.length) return rawCandleData;
    if (interval === "15m") return { ...rawCandleData, candles: aggToInterval(rawCandleData.candles, 900) };
    return rawCandleData;
  }, [rawCandleData, interval]);

  const windowedCandles = useMemo(() => {
    const MIN = 1, MAX = 9e13;
    return (candleData?.candles ?? [])
      .filter(c => isFinite(c.open) && isFinite(c.close) && c.open >= MIN && c.close >= MIN && c.open < MAX && c.high >= c.low)
      .sort((a, b) => a.time - b.time);
  }, [candleData]);

  // Vector + extra vec maps (forward-filled so lines are continuous)
  const vectorLine = useMemo(() => {
    if (!windowedCandles.length) return [];
    const raw = computeVectorLine(windowedCandles);
    const times = windowedCandles.map(c => c.time);
    return forwardFillVector(raw, times);
  }, [windowedCandles]);

  const extraVecMaps = useMemo((): Map<number, number>[] => {
    const times = windowedCandles.map(c => c.time);
    const base1m  = fetchInterval === "1m" ? (rawCandleData?.candles ?? []) : (raw1mData?.candles ?? []);
    const base5m  = (interval === "5m" || interval === "15m") ? (rawCandleData?.candles ?? []) : base1m.length ? aggToInterval(base1m, 300) : [];
    const base60m = fetchInterval === "60m" ? (rawCandleData?.candles ?? []) : (raw60mData?.candles ?? []);
    const currentSec = interval === "1m" ? 60 : interval === "5m" ? 300 : interval === "15m" ? 900 : 3600;
    return [
      { sec: 60, base: base1m }, { sec: 300, base: base5m },
      { sec: 900, base: base5m.length ? aggToInterval(base5m, 900) : [] },
      { sec: 3600, base: base60m },
    ]
      .filter(iv => iv.sec !== currentSec && iv.base.length)
      .map(iv => {
        const vec = computeVectorLine(iv.base);
        return new Map(forwardFillVector(vec, times).map(v => [v.time, v.value] as [number, number]));
      });
  }, [windowedCandles, rawCandleData, raw1mData, raw60mData, interval, fetchInterval]);

  // ML zones for chart
  const rthSettleOfDay = (ts: number) => Math.floor(ts / 86400) * 86400 + 20 * 3600 + 30 * 60;
  const mlZoneBands = useMemo((): ZoneBand[] => {
    if (!mlZonesData?.zones?.length) return [];
    return mlZonesData.zones.map(z => ({
      topPrice: z.top, bottomPrice: z.bottom,
      fromTime: z.from_ts, toTime: rthSettleOfDay(z.from_ts),
      color: z.is_bull
        ? `rgba(34,197,94,${(0.5 + z.score * 0.5).toFixed(2)})`
        : `rgba(239,68,68,${(0.5 + z.score * 0.5).toFixed(2)})`,
      label: `${z.is_bull ? "Support" : "Resist"} ${(z.score * 100).toFixed(0)}%`,
    }));
  }, [mlZonesData]);

  // Backtest signals using the "safe" tier config for TP/SL
  const allSignals = useMemo((): MCSignal[] => {
    const tp1 = parseFloat(editConfig.safe.tp1) || DEFAULT_TP1;
    const tp2 = parseFloat(editConfig.safe.tp2) || DEFAULT_TP2;
    const sl  = parseFloat(editConfig.safe.sl)  || DEFAULT_SL;
    return computeBacktestSignals(windowedCandles, vectorLine, extraVecMaps, mlZonesData?.zones ?? [], interval, tp1, tp2, sl);
  }, [windowedCandles, vectorLine, extraVecMaps, mlZonesData, interval, editConfig]);

  const filteredSignals = useMemo(() =>
    riskFilter === "all" ? allSignals : allSignals.filter(s => s.riskLevel === riskFilter),
    [allSignals, riskFilter]);

  // Chart confluence signals shaped for the chart component
  const chartSignals = useMemo(() => filteredSignals.map(s => ({
    time: s.time, price: s.price, direction: "Long" as const,
    tp1: s.tp1, tp2: s.tp2, sl: s.sl, toTime: s.time + 48 * 300,
    riskLevel: s.riskLevel,
    signalType: (mode === "backtest" && (s.outcome === "win_tp1" || s.outcome === "win_tp2"))
      ? "trend" as const : "confluence" as const,
  })), [filteredSignals, mode]);

  const handleBackTest = useCallback(() => { setMode("backtest"); setMcResult(null); setSuggestion(null); }, []);

  const handleRunMC = useCallback(() => {
    if (isRunning || !filteredSignals.length) return;
    setIsRunning(true); setMode("montecarlo");
    setTimeout(() => {
      try { setMcResult(runMonteCarlo(filteredSignals, 500, startBalance)); }
      finally { setIsRunning(false); }
    }, 0);
  }, [filteredSignals, isRunning, startBalance]);

  const handleSuggest = useCallback(() => {
    if (!filteredSignals.length) return;
    const tier = riskFilter === "all" ? "safe" : riskFilter;
    const sugg = generateSuggestion(filteredSignals, tier);
    setSuggestion(sugg); setShowSuggestion(true);
  }, [filteredSignals, riskFilter]);

  const handleApplySuggestion = useCallback(() => {
    if (!suggestion) return;
    setEditConfig(prev => ({
      ...prev,
      [suggestion.tier]: {
        tp1: String(suggestion.tp1),
        tp2: String(suggestion.tp2),
        sl:  String(suggestion.sl),
      },
    }));
    setShowSuggestion(false);
    setShowNotesPanel(true);
  }, [suggestion]);

  const handleSaveConfig = useCallback(async () => {
    setSaveStatus("saving");
    try {
      const body: Record<string, any> = {};
      for (const tier of ["safe", "risky", "riskiest"] as const) {
        body[tier] = {
          ...strategyConfig?.[tier],
          tp1_fixed: parseFloat(editConfig[tier].tp1) || 10,
          tp2_fixed: parseFloat(editConfig[tier].tp2) || 20,
          sl_fixed:  parseFloat(editConfig[tier].sl)  || 5,
        };
      }
      const r = await fetch("/api/strategy/config", { method: "PUT", headers: { "Content-Type": "application/json" }, body: JSON.stringify(body) });
      setSaveStatus(r.ok ? "saved" : "error");
      setTimeout(() => setSaveStatus("idle"), 2000);
    } catch { setSaveStatus("error"); setTimeout(() => setSaveStatus("idle"), 2000); }
  }, [editConfig, strategyConfig]);

  const handleSaveNote = useCallback(async () => {
    if (!learningsNote.trim()) return;
    setNoteStatus("saving");
    try {
      await fetch("/api/learnings/append", { method: "POST", headers: { "Content-Type": "application/json" }, body: JSON.stringify({ entry: learningsNote }) });
      setNoteStatus("saved"); setLearningsNote("");
      setTimeout(() => setNoteStatus("idle"), 2000);
    } catch { setNoteStatus("idle"); }
  }, [learningsNote]);

  const backtestStats = useMemo(() => {
    if (mode !== "backtest" || !filteredSignals.length) return null;
    const done = filteredSignals.filter(s => s.outcome !== "open");
    if (!done.length) return null;
    const wins = done.filter(s => s.outcome !== "loss").length;
    const totalPnl = done.reduce((s, x) => s + x.pnl, 0);
    return { total: filteredSignals.length, completed: done.length, wins, winRate: wins / done.length, totalPnl, avgPnl: totalPnl / done.length };
  }, [mode, filteredSignals]);

  const theme = CHART_THEMES.motivewave;

  // Chart height: reduce when equity panel is visible
  const showEquityPanel = mode === "montecarlo" && mcResult && mcResult.medianPath.length > 1;
  const showBacktestPanel = mode === "backtest" && filteredSignals.length > 0;

  return (
    <div className="flex flex-col h-screen overflow-hidden"
      style={{ background: MW.bg, color: MW.text, fontFamily: "'Trebuchet MS', 'Roboto', sans-serif" }}>

      {/* ── Header ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────── */}
      <header className="flex items-center gap-2 px-3 flex-shrink-0"
        style={{ height: 44, background: MW.toolbar, borderBottom: `1px solid ${MW.border}` }}>

        <Link href="/">
          <button className="flex items-center gap-1.5 px-2 h-7 rounded"
            style={{ background: MW.panel, border: `1px solid ${MW.border}`, color: MW.muted, cursor: "pointer", fontSize: 11 }}>
            <ChevronLeft className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />Chart
          </button>
        </Link>
        <div style={{ width: 1, height: 20, background: MW.border }} />
        <span style={{ fontSize: 13, fontWeight: 700, color: MW.text, letterSpacing: "0.04em" }}>
          Monte Carlo
        </span>
        <div style={{ width: 1, height: 20, background: MW.border }} />

        {/* Symbol */}
        <select value={selectedSymbol} onChange={e => setSelectedSymbol(e.target.value)}
          style={{ height: 28, padding: "0 8px", fontSize: 11, borderRadius: 4, cursor: "pointer", background: MW.panel, border: `1px solid ${MW.border}`, color: MW.text }}>
          <optgroup label="Futures">
            {FUTURES_SYMBOLS.map(s => <option key={s} value={s}>{s}</option>)}
          </optgroup>
        </select>

        {/* Interval */}
        <div className="flex items-center rounded overflow-hidden" style={{ border: `1px solid ${MW.border}`, background: MW.panel }}>
          {(["1m","5m","15m","60m"] as const).map(iv => (
            <button key={iv} onClick={() => setInterval(iv)}
              style={{ padding: "0 10px", height: 28, fontSize: 11, fontWeight: interval === iv ? 700 : 400, background: interval === iv ? MW.accent : "transparent", color: interval === iv ? "#fff" : MW.muted, cursor: "pointer", border: "none", borderRight: iv !== "60m" ? `1px solid ${MW.border}` : "none" }}>
              {iv}
            </button>
          ))}
        </div>

        {/* Risk filter */}
        <select value={riskFilter} onChange={e => setRiskFilter(e.target.value as RiskLevel)}
          style={{
            height: 28, padding: "0 8px", fontSize: 11, borderRadius: 4, cursor: "pointer",
            background: riskFilter === "safe" ? "rgba(38,200,122,0.12)" : riskFilter === "risky" ? "rgba(245,158,11,0.12)" : riskFilter === "riskiest" ? "rgba(239,68,68,0.12)" : "rgba(148,163,184,0.12)",
            color:      riskFilter === "safe" ? "#26c87a"               : riskFilter === "risky" ? "#f59e0b"               : riskFilter === "riskiest" ? "#ef4444"               : "#94a3b8",
            border: `1px solid ${riskFilter === "safe" ? "rgba(38,200,122,0.4)" : riskFilter === "risky" ? "rgba(245,158,11,0.4)" : riskFilter === "riskiest" ? "rgba(239,68,68,0.4)" : "rgba(148,163,184,0.4)"}`,
          }}>
          <option value="all">All Signals</option>
          <option value="safe">Safe</option>
          <option value="risky">Risky</option>
          <option value="riskiest">Riskiest</option>
        </select>

        <div style={{ width: 1, height: 20, background: MW.border }} />

        {/* Actions */}
        <button onClick={handleBackTest}
          style={{ display:"flex", alignItems:"center", gap:6, padding:"0 12px", height:28, borderRadius:4, fontSize:11, fontWeight:600,

        {filteredSignals.length > 0 && (
          <div style={{ fontSize: 11, color: MW.muted, background: MW.panel, border: `1px solid ${MW.border}`, borderRadius: 4, padding: "0 8px", height: 28, display:"flex", alignItems:"center" }}>
            {filteredSignals.length} signals · {windowedCandles.length} bars
          </div>
        )}
      </header>

      {/* ── Main ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────── */}
      <div className="flex flex-1 min-h-0 overflow-hidden relative">

        {/* ── Suggestion popup ───────────────────────────────────────────── */}
        {showSuggestion && (
          <div style={{
            position: "absolute", top: 10, left: "50%", transform: "translateX(-50%)", zIndex: 80,
            background: "linear-gradient(135deg,rgba(9,13,20,0.98),rgba(5,8,13,0.98))",
            border: `1.5px solid ${suggestion ? "#fbbf24" : MW.border}`,
            borderRadius: 8, padding: "16px 20px", minWidth: 320, maxWidth: 420,
            boxShadow: "0 8px 32px rgba(0,0,0,0.7)",

          }}>
            <div style={{ display:"flex", justifyContent:"space-between", alignItems:"center", marginBottom: 10 }}>
              <span style={{ fontSize: 13, fontWeight: 700, color: "#fbbf24", display:"flex", alignItems:"center", gap: 6 }}>
                <Lightbulb className="w-4 h-4" /> Suggested Exit Strategy

            {suggestion ? (

                  (tier: <span style={{ color: "#fbbf24" }}>{suggestion.tier}</span>):
                </div>
                <div style={{ display:"grid", gridTemplateColumns:"1fr 1fr", gap: "6px 12px", fontSize: 12, marginBottom: 12 }}>

                    {suggestion.ev >= 0 ? "+" : ""}{suggestion.ev.toFixed(2)} pts/trade
                  </span>
                  <span style={{ color: MW.muted }}>Est. Win Rate</span>

                    style={{ height: 30, padding:"0 12px", borderRadius: 4, fontSize: 11, cursor:"pointer", background:"transparent", border:`1px solid ${MW.border}`, color: MW.muted }}>
                    Dismiss
                  </button>

                  {tier} tier
                </div>
                {([["TP1 (pts)","tp1"],["TP2 (pts)","tp2"],["SL (pts)","sl"]] as const).map(([label, key]) => (

                      <span style={{ color: mcResult.avgPnl>=0?"#26c87a":"#ef5350" }}>{mcResult.avgPnl>=0?"+":""}{mcResult.avgPnl.toFixed(2)} pts avg</span>
                      <span style={{ color:"#f59e0b" }}>MaxDD {(mcResult.maxDrawdown*100).toFixed(1)}%</span>

                <span>Backtest — {filteredSignals.length} signals</span>
                {backtestStats && (
                  <>
                    <span style={{ color:"#26c87a" }}>WR {(backtestStats.winRate*100).toFixed(1)}%</span>
                    <span style={{ color: backtestStats.totalPnl>=0?"#26c87a":"#ef5350" }}>Total {backtestStats.totalPnl>=0?"+":""}{backtestStats.totalPnl.toFixed(2)} pts</span>
                    <span>Avg {backtestStats.avgPnl>=0?"+":""}{backtestStats.avgPnl.toFixed(2)} pts/trade</span>
                  </>
                )}
              </div>
              <div style={{ overflowY:"auto", flex:1 }}>
                <table style={{ width:"100%", borderCollapse:"collapse", fontSize:10, fontFamily:"'Trebuchet MS', monospace" }}>
                  <thead style={{ position:"sticky", top:0, background: MW.toolbar }}>
                    <tr>
                      {["Time (ET)","Tier","Entry","TP1","TP2","SL","Outcome","P&L"].map(h => (
                        <th key={h} style={{ padding:"3px 8px", textAlign:"left", color:MW.muted, fontWeight:600, borderBottom:`1px solid ${MW.border}` }}>{h}</th>
                      ))}
                    </tr>
                  </thead>
                  <tbody>
                    {filteredSignals.slice(-100).reverse().map((s, i) => {
                      const oc = s.outcome==="win_tp1"||s.outcome==="win_tp2"?"#26c87a":s.outcome==="loss"?"#ef5350":"#f59e0b";
                      const ol = s.outcome==="win_tp1"?"Win TP1":s.outcome==="win_tp2"?"Win TP2":s.outcome==="loss"?"Loss":"Open";
                      const tc = s.riskLevel==="safe"?"#26c87a":s.riskLevel==="risky"?"#f59e0b":"#ef4444";
                      return (
                        <tr key={i} style={{ cursor:"pointer" }}
                          onClick={() => chartRef.current?.scrollToTime(s.time, interval==="1m"?60:interval==="5m"?300:interval==="15m"?900:3600)}
                          onMouseEnter={e => (e.currentTarget.style.background = MW.panel)}
                          onMouseLeave={e => (e.currentTarget.style.background = "transparent")}>
                          <td style={{ padding:"3px 8px", color:MW.muted }}>
                            {new Date(s.time*1000).toLocaleString("en-US",{month:"short",day:"numeric",hour:"numeric",minute:"2-digit",hour12:true,timeZone:"America/New_York"})}
                          </td>
                          <td style={{ padding:"3px 8px", color:tc, fontWeight:600 }}>{s.riskLevel}</td>
                          <td style={{ padding:"3px 8px", color:MW.text }}>{s.price.toFixed(2)}</td>
                          <td style={{ padding:"3px 8px", color:"#22d3ee" }}>{s.tp1.toFixed(2)}</td>
                          <td style={{ padding:"3px 8px", color:"#67e8f9" }}>{s.tp2.toFixed(2)}</td>
                          <td style={{ padding:"3px 8px", color:"#ef5350" }}>{s.sl.toFixed(2)}</td>
                          <td style={{ padding:"3px 8px", color:oc, fontWeight:600 }}>{ol}</td>
                          <td style={{ padding:"3px 8px", color:s.pnl>=0?"#26c87a":"#ef5350", fontWeight:600 }}>{s.pnl>=0?"+":""}{s.pnl.toFixed(2)}</td>
                        </tr>
                      );
                    })}
                  </tbody>
                </table>
              </div>
            </div>
          )}
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

function formatDateShort(dateStr: string): string {
  const d = new Date(dateStr);
  return d.toLocaleDateString("en-US", { month: "short", day: "numeric", year: "numeric" });
}

function formatDateFull(dateStr: string): string {
  const d = new Date(dateStr);
  return d.toLocaleDateString("en-US", { weekday: "short", month: "short", day: "numeric", year: "numeric", hour: "numeric", minute: "2-digit" });
}

function TimelineChart({ articles, onSelectArticle }: { articles: NewsArticle[]; onSelectArticle: (a: NewsArticle) => void }) {
  const canvasRef = useRef<HTMLCanvasElement>(null);
  const containerRef = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null);
  const [hoveredIdx, setHoveredIdx] = useState<number | null>(null);
  const [tooltipPos, setTooltipPos] = useState<{ x: number; y: number } | null>(null);

  const sorted = useMemo(() => {
    return [...articles].sort((a, b) => new Date(a.publishedAt).getTime() - new Date(b.publishedAt).getTime());
  }, [articles]);

  const categoryOrder = ["fed_policy", "market_crash", "market_rally", "inflation", "geopolitical", "earnings", "recession", "crypto"];

  useEffect(() => {
    const canvas = canvasRef.current;
    const container = containerRef.current;
    if (!canvas || !container || sorted.length === 0) return;

    const dpr = window.devicePixelRatio || 1;
    const rect = container.getBoundingClientRect();
    const w = rect.width;
    const h = rect.height;
    canvas.width = w * dpr;
    canvas.height = h * dpr;
    canvas.style.width = w + "px";
    canvas.style.height = h + "px";

    const ctx = canvas.getContext("2d");
    if (!ctx) return;
    ctx.setTransform(dpr, 0, 0, dpr, 0, 0);
    ctx.clearRect(0, 0, w, h);

    const padding = { top: 30, right: 20, bottom: 50, left: 60 };
    const chartW = w - padding.left - padding.right;
    const chartH = h - padding.top - padding.bottom;

    const minTime = new Date(sorted[0].publishedAt).getTime();
    const maxTime = new Date(sorted[sorted.length - 1].publishedAt).getTime();
    const timeRange = maxTime - minTime || 1;

    ctx.fillStyle = "#131722";
    ctx.fillRect(0, 0, w, h);

    ctx.strokeStyle = "#1e222d";
    ctx.lineWidth = 1;

    const numTimeGridLines = Math.min(8, Math.max(4, Math.floor(chartW / 120)));
    for (let i = 0; i <= numTimeGridLines; i++) {
      const x = padding.left + (i / numTimeGridLines) * chartW;
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.moveTo(x, padding.top);
      ctx.lineTo(x, padding.top + chartH);
      ctx.stroke();

      const t = new Date(minTime + (i / numTimeGridLines) * timeRange);
      ctx.fillStyle = "#787b86";
      ctx.font = "10px -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, sans-serif";
      ctx.textAlign = "center";
      ctx.fillText(t.toLocaleDateString("en-US", { month: "short", year: "2-digit" }), x, h - padding.bottom + 18);
    }

    const laneH = chartH / categoryOrder.length;
    for (let i = 0; i < categoryOrder.length; i++) {
      const y = padding.top + i * laneH;
      ctx.strokeStyle = "#1e222d";
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.moveTo(padding.left, y);
      ctx.lineTo(padding.left + chartW, y);
      ctx.stroke();

      const cat = categoryOrder[i];
      const cfg = CATEGORY_CONFIG[cat];
      ctx.fillStyle = cfg?.color || "#787b86";
      ctx.font = "9px -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, sans-serif";
      ctx.textAlign = "right";
      const label = cat.replace("_", " ").replace(/\b\w/g, (c) => c.toUpperCase());
      ctx.fillText(label.length > 10 ? label.slice(0, 9) + "…" : label, padding.left - 5, y + laneH / 2 + 3);
    }

    for (let i = 0; i < sorted.length; i++) {
      const article = sorted[i];
      const t = new Date(article.publishedAt).getTime();
      const x = padding.left + ((t - minTime) / timeRange) * chartW;
      const laneIdx = categoryOrder.indexOf(article.category);
      const lane = laneIdx >= 0 ? laneIdx : 0;
      const y = padding.top + lane * laneH + laneH / 2;

      const cfg = CATEGORY_CONFIG[article.category];
      const isHovered = hoveredIdx === i;
      const radius = isHovered ? 7 : 5;

      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.arc(x, y, radius, 0, Math.PI * 2);
      ctx.fillStyle = isHovered ? (cfg?.color || "#6366f1") : (cfg?.bgColor || "rgba(99, 102, 241, 0.3)");
      ctx.fill();
      ctx.strokeStyle = cfg?.color || "#6366f1";
      ctx.lineWidth = isHovered ? 2.5 : 1.5;
      ctx.stroke();
    }
  }, [sorted, hoveredIdx]);

  const handleMouseMove = (e: React.MouseEvent) => {
    const canvas = canvasRef.current;
    const container = containerRef.current;
    if (!canvas || !container || sorted.length === 0) return;

    const rect = container.getBoundingClientRect();
    const mx = e.clientX - rect.left;
    const my = e.clientY - rect.top;
    const w = rect.width;
    const h = rect.height;

    const padding = { top: 30, right: 20, bottom: 50, left: 60 };
    const chartW = w - padding.left - padding.right;
    const chartH = h - padding.top - padding.bottom;

    const minTime = new Date(sorted[0].publishedAt).getTime();
    const maxTime = new Date(sorted[sorted.length - 1].publishedAt).getTime();
    const timeRange = maxTime - minTime || 1;
    const laneH = chartH / 8;

    let closest = -1;
    let closestDist = Infinity;

    for (let i = 0; i < sorted.length; i++) {
      const t = new Date(sorted[i].publishedAt).getTime();
      const x = padding.left + ((t - minTime) / timeRange) * chartW;
      const laneIdx = ["fed_policy", "market_crash", "market_rally", "inflation", "geopolitical", "earnings", "recession", "crypto"].indexOf(sorted[i].category);
      const y = padding.top + (laneIdx >= 0 ? laneIdx : 0) * laneH + laneH / 2;

      const dist = Math.sqrt((mx - x) ** 2 + (my - y) ** 2);
      if (dist < 15 && dist < closestDist) {
        closest = i;
        closestDist = dist;
      }
    }

    setHoveredIdx(closest >= 0 ? closest : null);
    setTooltipPos(closest >= 0 ? { x: mx, y: my } : null);
  };

  const handleClick = () => {
    if (hoveredIdx !== null && sorted[hoveredIdx]) {
      onSelectArticle(sorted[hoveredIdx]);
    }
  };

  const hoveredArticle = hoveredIdx !== null ? sorted[hoveredIdx] : null;

  return (
    <div ref={containerRef} className="relative w-full" style={{ height: 350 }}>
      <canvas
        ref={canvasRef}
        className="w-full h-full cursor-crosshair"
        onMouseMove={handleMouseMove}
        onMouseLeave={() => { setHoveredIdx(null); setTooltipPos(null); }}
        onClick={handleClick}
        data-testid="news-timeline-chart"
      />
      {hoveredArticle && tooltipPos && (
        <div
          className="absolute z-20 bg-popover border rounded-md shadow-lg p-2.5 max-w-xs pointer-events-none"
          style={{
            left: Math.min(tooltipPos.x + 12, (containerRef.current?.offsetWidth || 400) - 280),
            top: Math.max(0, tooltipPos.y - 60),
          }}
          data-testid="news-tooltip"
        >
          <div className="text-[10px] text-muted-foreground mb-1">{formatDateFull(hoveredArticle.publishedAt)}</div>
          <div className="text-xs font-medium leading-tight line-clamp-2">{hoveredArticle.title}</div>
          <div className="text-[10px] text-muted-foreground mt-1">{hoveredArticle.source} · Click to view</div>
        </div>
      )}
    </div>
  );
}

  const { data: categories } = useQuery<CategoryInfo[]>({
    queryKey: ["/api/news/categories"],
  });

  const { data: articlesData, isLoading } = useQuery<{ articles: NewsArticle[]; total: number }>({
    queryKey: ["/api/news/articles", selectedCategory],
    queryFn: async () => {
      const params = new URLSearchParams({ limit: "500" });
      if (selectedCategory !== "all") params.set("category", selectedCategory);
      const res = await fetch(`/api/news/articles?${params}`);
      if (!res.ok) throw new Error("Failed to fetch articles");
      return res.json();
    },
  });

  const fetchNewsMutation = useMutation({
    mutationFn: async () => {
      const res = await apiRequest("POST", "/api/news/fetch", {});
      return res.json();
    },
    onSuccess: () => {
      queryClient.invalidateQueries({ queryKey: ["/api/news/articles"] });
    },
  });

  const fetchHistoricalMutation = useMutation({
    mutationFn: async () => {
      const res = await apiRequest("POST", "/api/news/fetch-historical", {
        fromDate: "2020-01-01",
        toDate: new Date().toISOString().slice(0, 10),
      });
      return res.json();
    },
    onSuccess: () => {
      queryClient.invalidateQueries({ queryKey: ["/api/news/articles"] });
    },
  });

  const articles = articlesData?.articles || [];

  const categoryCounts = useMemo(() => {
    const counts: Record<string, number> = {};
    for (const a of articles) {
      counts[a.category] = (counts[a.category] || 0) + 1;
    }
    return counts;
  }, [articles]);

  const dateRange = useMemo(() => {
    if (articles.length === 0) return null;

    return {
      from: formatDateShort(sorted[0].publishedAt),

  return (

          <Newspaper className="w-5 h-5 text-primary" />
          <span className="font-semibold text-sm tracking-tight">Market News</span>
        </div>

        <div className="flex items-center gap-2 flex-1 min-w-0">
          <Select value={selectedCategory} onValueChange={setSelectedCategory}>
            <SelectTrigger className="w-48 h-8 text-xs" data-testid="select-news-category">
              <Filter className="w-3.5 h-3.5 mr-1.5" />
              <SelectValue />
            </SelectTrigger>
            <SelectContent>
              <SelectItem value="all">All Categories</SelectItem>
              {categories?.map((c) => (
                <SelectItem key={c.category} value={c.category}>
                  {c.label}
                </SelectItem>
              ))}
            </SelectContent>
          </Select>

          {dateRange && (
            <div className="flex items-center gap-1.5 text-xs text-muted-foreground">
              <Calendar className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
              <span>{dateRange.from} — {dateRange.to}</span>
            </div>
          )}
        </div>

        <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
          <Link href="/">
            <Button size="sm" variant="outline" data-testid="button-back-to-chart" className="text-xs gap-1.5 h-7">
              <BarChart3 className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
              Chart
            </Button>
          </Link>
          <Button
            size="sm"
            variant="outline"
            data-testid="button-fetch-news"
            className="text-xs gap-1.5 h-7"
            onClick={() => fetchNewsMutation.mutate()}
            disabled={fetchNewsMutation.isPending}
          >
            <RefreshCw className={`w-3.5 h-3.5 ${fetchNewsMutation.isPending ? "animate-spin" : ""}`} />
            Fetch Latest

            className="text-xs gap-1.5 h-7"
            onClick={() => fetchHistoricalMutation.mutate()}
            disabled={fetchHistoricalMutation.isPending}
          >
            <Download className={`w-3.5 h-3.5 ${fetchHistoricalMutation.isPending ? "animate-spin" : ""}`} />
            Fetch Historical

        </div>
      </header>

      <div className="flex-1 overflow-auto p-3 flex flex-col gap-3">
        {isLoading ? (
          <div className="flex-1 flex items-center justify-center">
            <div className="flex flex-col items-center gap-3 text-muted-foreground">

                  <RefreshCw className={`w-4 h-4 mr-2 ${fetchNewsMutation.isPending ? "animate-spin" : ""}`} />
                  Fetch Latest News

                  <Download className={`w-4 h-4 mr-2 ${fetchHistoricalMutation.isPending ? "animate-spin" : ""}`} />

                        : "border-border/50 bg-card/50 hover:bg-card"

              <TimelineChart articles={articles} onSelectArticle={setSelectedArticle} />
            </div>

            <div className="grid gap-2" data-testid="news-article-list">
              {articles.slice(0, 50).map((article) => {
                const cfg = CATEGORY_CONFIG[article.category];
                const Icon = cfg?.icon || Newspaper;
                const isSelected = selectedArticle?.id === article.id;
                return (
                  <div
                    key={article.id}

                      >
                        <Icon className="w-4 h-4" style={{ color: cfg?.color || "#6366f1" }} />
                      </div>
                    </div>
                    <div className="flex-1 min-w-0">
                      <div className="flex items-start justify-between gap-2">
                        <h3 className="text-sm font-medium leading-tight line-clamp-2" data-testid={`text-article-title-${article.id}`}>
                          {article.title}
                        </h3>
                        <a
                          href={article.url}
                          target="_blank"
                          rel="noopener noreferrer"
                          onClick={(e) => e.stopPropagation()}
                          className="flex-shrink-0 text-muted-foreground hover:text-primary transition-colors"
                          data-testid={`link-article-${article.id}`}
                        >
                          <ExternalLink className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />

                      <div className="flex items-center gap-2 mt-1">

                        )}
                      </div>
                      {isSelected && article.description && (
                        <p className="text-xs text-muted-foreground mt-2 leading-relaxed">
                          {article.description}
                        </p>
                      )}
                    </div>
                  </div>
                );
              })}
            </div>
          </>
        )}
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

import { useMemo } from "react";
import { useQuery } from "@tanstack/react-query";
import { Link } from "wouter";
import { ArrowLeft, TrendingUp, TrendingDown, Minus, Activity, BarChart3, AlertTriangle } from "lucide-react";

interface CandleBar {
  time: number; open: number; high: number; low: number; close: number; volume?: number; rth?: boolean;
}

// ── RTH helper ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
function isRTH(ts: number): boolean {
  const d = new Date(ts * 1000);
  const day = d.getUTCDay();
  if (day === 0 || day === 6) return false;
  const m = d.getUTCHours() * 60 + d.getUTCMinutes();
  return m >= 13 * 60 + 30 && m < 21 * 60;
}

function isToday(ts: number): boolean {
  const now = new Date();
  const d   = new Date(ts * 1000);
  return d.getUTCFullYear() === now.getUTCFullYear() &&
    d.getUTCMonth() === now.getUTCMonth() &&
    d.getUTCDate()  === now.getUTCDate();
}

function isYesterday(ts: number): boolean {
  const yest = new Date(Date.now() - 86400_000);
  const d    = new Date(ts * 1000);
  return d.getUTCFullYear() === yest.getUTCFullYear() &&
    d.getUTCMonth() === yest.getUTCMonth() &&
    d.getUTCDate()  === yest.getUTCDate();
}

// ── Analysis engine ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

interface DayStats {
  date: string;
  open: number; high: number; low: number; close: number;
  range: number;
  bullCandles: number; bearCandles: number; totalCandles: number;
  bullPct: number;
  openToHigh: number; openToLow: number;
  closedUpperHalf: boolean;
  highOfDay: number; lowOfDay: number;
}

function analyzeDays(candles: CandleBar[]): DayStats[] {
  const byDay = new Map<string, CandleBar[]>();
  for (const c of candles) {
    // Include all candles (RTH + ETH); skip weekend-only days below via < 3 bar filter
    const d = new Date(c.time * 1000);
    const key = `${d.getUTCFullYear()}-${String(d.getUTCMonth() + 1).padStart(2, "0")}-${String(d.getUTCDate()).padStart(2, "0")}`;
    if (!byDay.has(key)) byDay.set(key, []);
    byDay.get(key)!.push(c);
  }
  const result: DayStats[] = [];
  for (const [date, bars] of byDay) {
    const sorted = [...bars].sort((a, b) => a.time - b.time);
    if (sorted.length < 3) continue;
    const open  = sorted[0].open;
    const close = sorted[sorted.length - 1].close;
    const high  = Math.max(...sorted.map(c => c.high));
    const low   = Math.min(...sorted.map(c => c.low));
    const range = high - low;
    const bull  = sorted.filter(c => c.close > c.open).length;
    const bear  = sorted.filter(c => c.close < c.open).length;
    result.push({
      date, open, high, low, close, range,
      bullCandles: bull, bearCandles: bear, totalCandles: sorted.length,
      bullPct: sorted.length ? bull / sorted.length : 0.5,
      openToHigh: high - open, openToLow: open - low,
      closedUpperHalf: close > (high + low) / 2,
      highOfDay: high, lowOfDay: low,
    });
  }
  return result.sort((a, b) => a.date.localeCompare(b.date));
}

interface Prediction {
  title: string;
  body: string;
  bias: "bullish" | "bearish" | "neutral";
  confidence: "high" | "medium" | "low";
  category: "trend" | "reversion" | "range" | "structure";
}

function generatePredictions(days: DayStats[], todayCandles: CandleBar[]): Prediction[] {
  const preds: Prediction[] = [];
  if (days.length < 2) return preds;

  const recent  = days.slice(-5);
  const today   = days[days.length - 1];
  const prev    = days[days.length - 2];
  const prev2   = days.length >= 3 ? days[days.length - 3] : null;

  // ── Sort today's live candles ──
  const todaySorted = [...todayCandles].sort((a, b) => a.time - b.time);
  const liveHigh = todaySorted.length ? Math.max(...todaySorted.map(c => c.high)) : null;
  const liveLow  = todaySorted.length ? Math.min(...todaySorted.map(c => c.low))  : null;
  const liveClose = todaySorted.length ? todaySorted[todaySorted.length - 1].close : null;
  const liveOpen  = todaySorted.length ? todaySorted[0].open : null;

  // ── 1. Multi-day directional streak → reversion bias ──────────────────────
  const streak = {
    bull: recent.filter(d => d.close > d.open).length,
    bear: recent.filter(d => d.close < d.open).length,
  };
  if (streak.bear >= 4) {
    preds.push({
      title: "Extended Bearish Streak — Reversion Watch",
      body: `The market has closed bearish ${streak.bear} of the last ${recent.length} RTH sessions. Extended one-sided moves historically attract counter-trend participation. A bounce or consolidation period becomes increasingly probable — watch for bullish price action near established support zones.`,
      bias: "bullish",
      confidence: streak.bear >= 5 ? "high" : "medium",
      category: "reversion",
    });
  } else if (streak.bull >= 4) {
    preds.push({
      title: "Extended Bullish Streak — Reversion Watch",
      body: `The market has closed bullish ${streak.bull} of the last ${recent.length} RTH sessions. Markets rarely extend in one direction without pausing. A pullback or range day becomes increasingly probable — watch for short opportunities at overhead resistance.`,
      bias: "bearish",
      confidence: streak.bull >= 5 ? "high" : "medium",
      category: "reversion",
    });
  }

  // ── 2. Today's intraday bear structure → late-day bounce? ─────────────────
  if (liveClose !== null && liveOpen !== null && liveHigh !== null && liveLow !== null && todaySorted.length >= 6) {
    const moveDown = liveOpen - liveClose;
    const moveUp   = liveClose - liveOpen;
    const liveRange = liveHigh - liveLow;
    const closePct = liveRange > 0 ? (liveClose - liveLow) / liveRange : 0.5;

    if (moveDown > 15 && closePct < 0.35) {
      preds.push({
        title: "Heavy Selling Today — Late Mean Reversion Possible",
        body: `Price is down ${moveDown.toFixed(1)} pts from the open and closing near the low of day. When sessions are heavily one-sided early, mean-reversion buying often appears into the final 60–90 minutes of RTH. Watch for a bullish imbalance signal near the session low.`,
        bias: "bullish",
        confidence: moveDown > 25 ? "high" : "medium",
        category: "reversion",
      });
    } else if (moveUp > 15 && closePct > 0.65) {
      preds.push({
        title: "Strong Buying Today — Late Profit-Taking Possible",
        body: `Price is up ${moveUp.toFixed(1)} pts from the open near the high of day. Late-session selling pressure (profit-taking) often compresses gains into the close. Watch for a short opportunity near the high if volume drops off in the last hour.`,
        bias: "bearish",
        confidence: moveUp > 25 ? "high" : "medium",
        category: "reversion",
      });
    }
  }

  // ── 3. Range analysis vs yesterday ────────────────────────────────────────
  if (prev.range > 0) {
    const todayRange = liveHigh !== null && liveLow !== null ? liveHigh - liveLow : today.range;
    const rangeRatio = todayRange / prev.range;
    if (rangeRatio < 0.45 && todaySorted.length > 10) {
      preds.push({
        title: "Compression Day — Breakout Setup Building",
        body: `Today's range (${todayRange.toFixed(1)} pts) is only ${(rangeRatio * 100).toFixed(0)}% of yesterday's range (${prev.range.toFixed(1)} pts). Tight compression typically precedes expansion. A breakout above/below today's range could produce a fast 10–20 pt move. Watch the extremes closely.`,
        bias: "neutral",
        confidence: "medium",
        category: "range",
      });
    } else if (rangeRatio > 2.5) {
      preds.push({
        title: "High Volatility Expansion — Expect Continuation or Snap-Back",
        body: `Today's range (${todayRange.toFixed(1)} pts) is ${(rangeRatio).toFixed(1)}× yesterday's. High-volatility days often see range contraction the following session. If there is no clear directional close, tomorrow may chop or consolidate.`,
        bias: "neutral",
        confidence: "low",
        category: "range",
      });
    }
  }

  // ── 4. Open vs prior day high/low ─────────────────────────────────────────
  if (liveOpen !== null) {
    if (liveOpen > prev.high) {
      preds.push({
        title: "Gap Above Prior Day High",
        body: `Today opened at ${liveOpen.toFixed(2)}, above yesterday's high of ${prev.high.toFixed(2)}. Gap-up opens above prior highs often either fill the gap (bearish reversion) or accelerate — the first 30 minutes of RTH direction is the tell. If price holds above ${prev.high.toFixed(2)}, the bullish trend continues; a fill of the gap targets ${prev.close.toFixed(2)}.`,
        bias: "neutral",
        confidence: "medium",
        category: "structure",
      });
    } else if (liveOpen < prev.low) {
      preds.push({
        title: "Gap Below Prior Day Low",
        body: `Today opened at ${liveOpen.toFixed(2)}, below yesterday's low of ${prev.low.toFixed(2)}. Gap-down opens below prior lows are structurally bearish. Watch for a dead-cat bounce back to ${prev.low.toFixed(2)} (which becomes resistance) then continuation lower.`,
        bias: "bearish",
        confidence: "medium",
        category: "structure",
      });
    }
  }

  // ── 5. High/low of day vs prior range midpoint ────────────────────────────
  const prevMid = (prev.high + prev.low) / 2;
  if (liveClose !== null) {
    if (liveClose > prev.high && prev2 && prev.close > prev2.high) {
      preds.push({
        title: "Two Consecutive Days Closing Above Prior High",
        body: `Today and yesterday both closed above the prior day's high. This stair-stepping pattern signals strong institutional buying. The path of least resistance is up — dips to the prior day's high (${prev.high.toFixed(2)}) are buy opportunities with trend confirmation.`,
        bias: "bullish",
        confidence: "high",
        category: "trend",
      });
    } else if (liveClose < prev.low && prev2 && prev.close < prev2.low) {
      preds.push({
        title: "Two Consecutive Days Closing Below Prior Low",
        body: `Today and yesterday both closed below the prior day's low. This is a distribution pattern consistent with institutional selling. Rallies to the prior day's low (${prev.low.toFixed(2)}) are likely short opportunities in a downtrend.`,
        bias: "bearish",
        confidence: "high",
        category: "trend",
      });
    }
  }

  // ── 6. Bull/bear candle imbalance today ───────────────────────────────────
  if (todaySorted.length >= 10) {
    const todayBull = todaySorted.filter(c => c.close > c.open).length;
    const todayBear = todaySorted.filter(c => c.close < c.open).length;
    const todayTotal = todaySorted.length;
    const todayBullPct = todayBull / todayTotal;
    if (todayBullPct > 0.72) {
      preds.push({
        title: "Bullish Candle Dominance Today",
        body: `${todayBull} of ${todayTotal} 5-min candles today (${(todayBullPct * 100).toFixed(0)}%) are closing green. The intraday structure is strongly bullish — breadth of this quality typically sustains into the close. Pullbacks are likely shallow; dip-buying has been rewarded.`,
        bias: "bullish",
        confidence: todayBullPct > 0.80 ? "high" : "medium",
        category: "trend",
      });
    } else if (todayBullPct < 0.28) {
      preds.push({
        title: "Bearish Candle Dominance Today",
        body: `${todayBear} of ${todayTotal} 5-min candles today (${((1 - todayBullPct) * 100).toFixed(0)}%) are closing red. Sustained selling breadth like this typically does not reverse cleanly intraday. Expect continued pressure — any bounces are likely to be sold.`,
        bias: "bearish",
        confidence: todayBullPct < 0.20 ? "high" : "medium",
        category: "trend",
      });
    }
  }

  // ── 7. High of day not extended → room above ──────────────────────────────
  if (liveHigh !== null && liveClose !== null && prev.range > 0) {
    const distFromHigh = liveHigh - liveClose;
    const distFromLow  = liveClose - (liveLow ?? liveClose);
    if (distFromHigh > 0 && distFromLow / (distFromHigh + distFromLow) > 0.75 && todaySorted.length >= 8) {
      preds.push({
        title: "Price Compressing Near Session Low",
        body: `Current price is ${distFromHigh.toFixed(1)} pts below the day's high of ${liveHigh.toFixed(2)} and only ${distFromLow.toFixed(1)} pts above the low. With price hugging the lower quarter of the session range, the risk/reward for a long trade near support improves significantly.`,
        bias: "bullish",
        confidence: "medium",
        category: "range",
      });
    } else if (distFromLow > 0 && distFromHigh / (distFromHigh + distFromLow) > 0.75 && todaySorted.length >= 8) {
      preds.push({
        title: "Price Compressing Near Session High",
        body: `Current price is only ${distFromHigh.toFixed(1)} pts below the day's high of ${liveHigh.toFixed(2)}. With price in the upper quarter of the range and ${distFromLow.toFixed(1)} pts of air below, the risk/reward for shorts near resistance improves.`,
        bias: "bearish",
        confidence: "medium",
        category: "range",
      });
    }
  }

  // Fallback if no strong signals
  if (preds.length === 0) {
    preds.push({
      title: "No Strong Directional Bias Detected",
      body: "Market conditions are mixed or neutral. No strong trending or reversal patterns are present. Wait for clearer structure before committing to a directional trade. Focus on executing at high-confluence zone levels.",
      bias: "neutral",
      confidence: "low",
      category: "trend",
    });
  }

  return preds;
}
